PEOS software. • Experience in developing 3D simulation model for the lighting and camera systems as given in SCC (Annexure 9). • Proof for PQC 1 & 2 above in the form of authorization letter, partn er agreement and copy of purchase order with complete certificate etc., has to be uploaded in the portal. Guaranteed time of delivery-specific performance of Purchase Order; The time of delivery is the essence of the order and the ite m to be supplied within 6 Months from the date of Purchase Order. In the event of part supply, NIOT shall withhold the entire payment until the whole of the supply as per the contract is delivered Payment: NO ADVANCE PAYMENT WILL BE MADE. 1. 90% of the payment for the ANSYS SPEOS software shall be released upo n the successful installation of the software. 2. 90% of the payment for the Workstation, along with the six-month simulation adoption support, shall be released upon the successful compl etion of the work specified in Annexure 1. 3. The remaining 10% of the above payments for the ANSYS SPEOS software and the Workstation with simulation adoption support shall be released af ter the successful completion of the warranty period. Section III Scope of work Scope of Work To develop 3D Simulation model for the positioning of Camera an Scope d Lighting in MATSYA 6000 using ANSYS SPEOS software in the w ork station supplied by the vendor. Simulation work should include implementing the various camera s and lighting systems in MATSYA 6000 using CAD MODEL. 3D simulation model encompasses optical system design, simulat ion, optimization, and validation focusing on light propagation, hu Simulati man vision effects, Multiphysics integration, illumination, scatteri on work ng, and visibility in aquatic environments. The vendor must provide a performance report that includes 3D s imulation model. The simulation report should include all simulati on execution cases, and the report must be in Microsoft word for mat along with images in JPEG format. Scope of Work The Scope of work is to supply ANSYS SPEOS software, 3D simulation model

for Camera and Lighting Position in MATSYA 6000 and training as Prescribed in Annexure 1. The software should be installed at customer’s site (NIOT office) an d training on the application software for simulation should be provided. Simulat ion of Camera and Lighting Position in MATSYA 6000 shall be executed at NIOT Chennai, Premise using ANSYS SPEOS software in the work station supplied by t he vendor. The scope of Simulation of Camera and Lighting Position for MATSYA 6000 is illustrated in Table 3. Installation and Commissioning · The supplier should install and commission the software at NIOT office. Training and Documentation · The supplier should provide comprehensive training at NIOT office covering all the features of the software and the procedure to install it in computer. · During training, the supplier should train in the development of simulation and various iterations used for the development of 3D Simulation model for the positioning of Camera and Lighting in MA TSYA 6000 as per Annexure-1 License and hardware failure · During the license period, in case of license server failure, the supplier should provide license repl acement to NIOT, without any additional cost. Acceptance · After the installation and commissioning of the software at NIOT office, all its features and functio nalities should be demonstrated by the supplier. Based on the above-mentioned installation, com missioning and successful completion of the training the acceptance will be given. . 8.
